updates.title: TritonAI Harness access and builder resources expand
updates.details:
UC San Diego faculty and staff can request access to the TritonAI Gateway, receive approved billing and usage limits, and install the TritonAI Harness on supported Mac or Windows computers. The TritonAI Harness is UC San Diego's primary supported Gateway client. Claude Code and Codex remain supported alternatives.

The UCSD Skills Library publishes reusable, reviewed capabilities. The Build section explains how the TritonAI Harness, n8n, developer APIs, and supported hosting fit together. Request access and set up the TritonAI Harness or browse the Skills Library.

updates.title: AI Contract Reviewer and Transcript Matcher in production
updates.details: Two human-supervised TritonAI workflows are in production. Contract Review compares relevant language with approved positions and prepares findings and proposed redlines for a qualified reviewer. Transcript Matching compares incoming transcript documents with student records and routes uncertain cases to staff. Its published validation sample reported 99.86% accuracy across more than 3,700 records, with five errors. Data handling and model routes follow the controls approved for each production service.

updates.title: Class Planner in production
updates.details: Class Planner is in production, helping students generate and compare schedule alternatives from course meeting information, preferences, and unavailable times. Students remain responsible for checking current course details and availability before enrollment.

updates.title: TritonAI Harness pilot advances
updates.details: The TritonAI Harness pilot advanced its support for bounded, tool-using workflows through the common model gateway and reusable skills. Availability and supported capabilities are confirmed through the developer-access process.

updates.title: Developer pilot and model catalog updates
updates.details: The developer pilot added workflow capabilities and expanded the models evaluated through the gateway. Because the catalog and rates change, use the Model Hub for current availability, capabilities, and published rates.

updates.title: Platform reliability work
updates.details: Platform reliability, integration quality, and operational monitoring work continued across TritonGPT and its instructional pilot.

updates.title: Platform update: Onyx 3.3
updates.details: TritonGPT upgrades to Onyx v3.3. Deployed features include structured indexing for spreadsheets and CSV files, smoother chat streaming with live LaTeX rendering, queued messages, image extraction from PDFs, and connector improvements. System hardening and observability work also improved performance and reliability.

updates.title: UC San Diego Assistant launches in the mobile app
updates.details: The UC San Diego Assistant is available in the official UC San Diego mobile app on iOS and Android. Students, faculty, and staff can ask about campus resources, parking availability, dining options, library information, and more from their phone. Powered by TritonGPT, the assistant delivers the same campus knowledge available on Blink and the TritonGPT web interface in a mobile experience.

updates.title: TritonGPT widget adds live campus data
updates.details: The TritonGPT widget now provides live parking availability and current busyness levels at Geisel Library. The redesigned interface makes it easier to follow how the AI generates responses. System updates also improved performance and reliability.

updates.title: New models, campus tools, and search improvements
updates.details: Adds GPT 5.4, Gemini 3.1 Pro and Flash, Gemma 4 26b, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, and retires the OpenAI 4 Series. The UC San Diego Assistant gains Parking and Busyness tools, the Internet Search Assistant moves to a more reliable web search, and answer quality and safety have been improved across the platform. Read the April 14 release details.

updates.title: New interface, personalization, and Deep Research
updates.details: This release refreshes the chat interface and organizes Documents and Chat Folders into Projects. It also adds GPT-5.1, Gemini 3 Pro, Deep Research, and personalization options. Read the November 24 release details.

updates.title: GPT-5 becomes available
updates.details: OpenAI's GPT-5 model is available for all AI Assistants.

updates.title: TritonGPT powers AI overviews in Blink search
updates.details: Blink search results now feature an AI overview powered by the TritonGPT UC San Diego Assistant.

updates.title: New default model and assistants
updates.details: GPT OSS, OpenAI's open-weight model, now powers TritonGPT by default. Models are served through a centralized API service for consistent management. The new Data Dictionary Assistant helps report developers navigate data available in the Activity Hubs.

updates.title: Embedding and model-routing updates
updates.details:
An improved embedding model increases response accuracy. All models are now served through LiteLLM for more efficient and scalable model management.

Users can also change their default model in User Settings.

updates.title: Expert Notetaker
updates.details: Paste a meeting transcript to generate a detailed summary with action items.

updates.title: AI chatbot widget launches on Blink
updates.details: The UC San Diego Assistant is available as a chatbot widget on Blink. Learn about the TritonGPT chatbot widget.

updates.title: TritonGPT becomes available to students
updates.details: Students now have access to TritonGPT. Read the TritonLink access information.

updates.title: GPT-4.1 becomes available
updates.details: GPT-4.1 is available for all AI Assistants. It supports text and image inputs and brings updated coding, reasoning, and instruction-following capabilities. This release also includes fixes for My Documents.

updates.title: Llama 4 Scout becomes the default model
updates.details: Llama 4 Scout replaces Llama 3.3 as the default model.

updates.title: My Documents
updates.details: Users can create folders and upload documents to organize source material and generate new content from multiple files.

updates.title: UC San Diego Assistant context routing
updates.details: The UC San Diego Assistant now evaluates prompts to determine when UC San Diego context applies. The change reduces irrelevant campus context when the General AI Assistant is a better fit.

updates.title: New navigation, model selection, and expanded context
updates.details: TritonGPT introduces grouped chat history, assistant-specific threads, and an Explore Assistants panel. Users can choose between GPT-4o and Llama 3.3 70B. Backend upgrades expand the context window to 128,000 tokens. User Settings adds theme selection, auto-scroll, keyboard shortcuts, and full chat deletion. Read the April 2 release details.

updates.title: Related Questions improvements
updates.details: TritonGPT upgrades to a newer Onyx release and improves Related Questions. Users can select a related question to add it to the prompt window.

updates.title: Onyx, Llama 3.3, and expanded campus sources
updates.details: TritonGPT upgrades to Onyx, formerly Danswer, which brings chat and search together. The release also adds Llama 3.3 and expands the number of indexed websites to 63.

updates.title: JD Helper, Internet Search, and Related Questions
updates.details: JD Helper adds support for creating job postings and interview questions from a Position Overview. Internet Search provides current web information. Related Questions suggests follow-up topics in the Fund Manager Coach, UC San Diego, and Internet Search assistants.

updates.title: Assistant switching improvements
updates.details: A cleaner interface makes it easier to move between AI Assistants.

updates.title: Email Phishing Analyzer
updates.details: Users can upload or paste an email for analysis. The assistant returns a risk rating and explains the factors behind it.

updates.title: File uploads, saved chats, and assistant switching
updates.details: TritonGPT adds saved chats, file uploads, document search, assistant switching, a Prompt Gallery, shared chats, and source interaction. Fund Manager Coach also becomes available. Read the August 13 release details.

updates.title: Campus rollout completes
updates.details: TritonGPT becomes available to employees in campus and Health Sciences units, reaching close to 37,000 faculty, staff, and student staff. People who have trouble accessing the service can contact the Service Desk.

updates.title: Llama 3 and vLLM updates
updates.details: TritonGPT adds Llama 3 for the UC San Diego Assistant and General AI Assistant. The vLLM environment also receives an upgrade to serve models more efficiently.

updates.title: Campus single sign-on
updates.details: TritonGPT adopts campus single sign-on and receives several interface improvements.

updates.title: JD Helper improvements
updates.details: JD Helper receives fixes and clearer instructions for retrieving job cards. Its system prompt also changes to produce more consistent output.

updates.title: Production candidate launches
updates.details: TritonGPT launches a production candidate for employees in campus and Health Sciences units, with a Danswer enterprise code base, a larger embedding model, and interface improvements.

updates.title: Hardware capacity expands
updates.details: Additional hardware expands capacity ahead of the campus launch.

updates.title: TritonGPT proof of concept
updates.details: The initial proof of concept launches for more than 400 pilot users.
